en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a grand Romanesque-style cathedral with two tall western towers and a long nave façade, viewed from across a series of terraced pools and fountains. People are gathered on the steps leading up to the church. Trees frame both sides of the scene. At the bottom front of the image the words "Pécs" and "Székesegyház" are printed. The reverse side is a standard divided-back postcard layout with Hungarian text about postage and a Budapest printer's mark.
